items.caption: A modern redraw of 巴 shows its oracle-script-style form, used here to illustrate the proposed sound component in 爸.
items.alt: Black glyph with a tall left stroke and curved strokes extending to the right.
items.selection_reason: Shows 巴 separately as the proposed sound component. This redraw does not establish the form’s original referent or securely date it.
items.period: Purported Shang oracle-script style; the period is unspecified.

items.caption: A modern redraw of 父 shows its oracle-script-style form, the component associated with the father meaning in 爸.
items.alt: Black glyph with an upright left stroke, a curved mark arching above and to the right, and long diagonal strokes descending from their junction.
items.selection_reason: Shows 父 separately as the proposed meaning component. It does not attest the complete graph 爸 in this period.
items.period: Shang oracle-script style; a style attribution, not an attestation date for 爸.

limitations.text: These redraws show 父 and 巴 separately, not an early occurrence of the complete graph 爸. They cannot establish when the two components were combined.
巴’s early identity and original referent remain disputed, so its shape alone cannot confirm the proposed sound relationship in 爸.
